full_judgment:
Mustafa Kamal, C.J.: In a suit for partition, Partition Suit No. 39 of 1983, the plaintiff-respondents claimed partition of 1.52 acres of land. The plaintiffs amended the plaint and prayed for partition of 1.6114 acres of land which was allowed and against which amendment the defendant-petitioners did not prefer any revision. The learned Subordinate Judge, Joypurhat decreed the suit in preliminary form allowing partition of 1.51 acres of land, accepting the case of title of the plaintiff-respondents. Two sets of defendants filed two sets of appeals, Other Class Appeal Nos. 35 and 36 of 1990 and by a common judgment dated 6.10.1997 the learned Additional District Judge, Joypurhat dismissed both the appeals and found that the trial court by inadvertence did not dispose of the plaintiff-respondents' application for amendment of the plaint and as such decreed the suit for partition of 1.614 acres of land. The defendant-petitioners preferred revisional application there from, Civil Order No. 1880 of 1998, which was summarily rejected by a learned Single Judge of the High Court Division by judgment and order dated 24.2.1998 from which the defendant-petitioners have preferred this petition for leave to appeal. 

 2. Mr. A. B. M. Nurul Islam, learned Advocate for the defendant-petitioners, submits that the plaintiff-respondents having preferred no cross-appeal against the judgment and decree of the trial court, the appellate court: below erred in law in enhancing the share of the plaintiffs and the High Court Division also erred in law in not rectifying the same.
